correctness.rationale: Depth-j types are exactly finite sets of depth-(j-1) child types, so 2,4,16 possible depth-1,2,3 codes. For each code t the level-two reduction beta(t) follows by mapping child level-two type 0 to level-one 0 and 1,2,3 to 1. Summing distinct-child-demand weights lambda=(1,2,3,4) over all tree edges establishes |V| >= sum_v h(t_v) + lambda_{beta(type(root))}, h=1+D-lambda_beta. Independently reproduced h=(0,0,0,0,1,1,3,3,2,2,4,4,5,5,7,7), all >=0 and 16-distinct-types sum=44. Type 4 forces a path of length three, hence the root must have type >=4, giving root weight >=3, lower bound 47. Independently parsed witness.json: 47 vertices, 46 edges, unique root, all vertices reachable, actual computed tau_3 labels equal supplied labels and cover 0..15; 44+3=47. This verifies constructive upper bound and universal lower bound without enumerating all smaller trees.
residual_risks: Tree edges must mean immediate-child forward accessibility; for descendants, DAGs, counted modalities or propositional labels this exact bound does not follow.

final_claim: Among finite unlabeled atom-free one-modality immediate-child rooted directed trees that realize all 16 depth-three modal types somewhere, the least number of vertices is exactly 47.
